arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
echo LEADS_INSTALLER_DIAGNOSTIC_BEGIN
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/deploy_project_only.py')
for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
 if 79<=i<=117: print('VALIDATION_SOURCE',i,l[:210])
PY
root=/opt/telegram-robot-leads
target=9596a0687aeed20e03bcd1f91ae2ad6d830cd523
before=$(sudo -n cat "$root/.verified-source-commit" | tr -d '\r\n')
echo "INSTALLED_MARKER=$before"
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-installer-diagnostic.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work/repo"
test "$(git -C "$work/repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
cd "$work/repo"
files=(scripts/lead_health.py scripts/leads_operational_report.py scripts/operation_policy.py scripts/organic_growth.py scripts/public_group_discovery.py scripts/member_groups.py scripts/growth_radar.py scripts/activate_project_only.py scripts/project_hygiene.py scripts/safe_runtime.py scripts/telegram-robot-leads-status.sh scripts/deploy_project_only.py)
tar -czf "$work/release.tgz" "${files[@]}"
echo "BUNDLE_FILE_COUNT=$(tar -tzf "$work/release.tgz" | wc -l)"
set +e
output=$(sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -B "$root/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$work/release.tgz" --commit "$target" --expected-installed "$before" 2>&1)
rc=$?
set -e
echo "DRY_RUN_EXIT=$rc"
echo "DRY_RUN_OUTPUT=$output"
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ];then echo LEADS_INSTALLER_DIAGNOSTIC_IDENTIFIED_BLOCK;exit "$rc";fi
echo LEADS_INSTALLER_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS
